email_body:
Dear Ilse Sant,

I am writing to apply for the Digital Communication Specialist role at BENEO-Orafti Belgium in Tienen. With hands-on experience in social media management, paid LinkedIn campaigns, and digital content creation, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to BENEO's mission of advancing healthier nutrition.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage social media channels, create engaging content, and optimise campaigns for client websites. I have also built and maintained websites, implemented SEO strategies, and used generative AI tools like ChatGPT to streamline content creation. My background in front-end development and analytics ensures I can handle KPI reporting and collaborate effectively with creative agencies.

I am particularly drawn to BENEO's purpose-driven culture and focus on health and nutrition. I am confident that my skills in digital communication and my commercial mindset would allow me to make a meaningful impact on your global marketing projects.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can contribute to your team.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Ilse Sant,

I am writing to express my interest in the Digital Communication Specialist position at BENEO-Orafti Belgium, as advertised. With a strong foundation in digital marketing, social media management, and content creation, I am eager to bring my skills to your team in Tienen and contribute to BENEO's mission of advancing healthier nutrition through innovative food ingredients.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I handle on-page SEO, keyword research, and content creation for client websites, while also managing social media channels and tracking performance using tools like Google Analytics and Search Console. I have experience in planning and optimising paid campaigns, including LinkedIn ads, and creating engaging digital content such as blog posts, newsletters, and website copy. My proficiency with generative AI tools like ChatGPT and my ability to prompt them effectively allows me to streamline content production and enhance campaign outcomes.

Previously, as a Web & SEO Specialist at Knowledge Experts, I built and maintained WordPress websites, integrated social media, and ran SEO analyses. I also developed a multi-page website for a Belgian youth chess champion, implementing structured data and technical SEO audits that measurably improved search visibility. My front-end development background gives me a solid understanding of web technologies, enabling me to collaborate effectively with creative agencies and internal teams.

I am particularly attracted to BENEO's purpose-driven culture and its focus on health and nutrition. I am confident that my commercial feeling, analytical eye, and storytelling abilities in English would allow me to successfully manage your global social media channels, create impactful promotional content, and report on advertisement KPIs. I am excited about the opportunity to shape the digital future of BENEO-Orafti Belgium and would welcome the chance to discuss how my experience aligns with your needs.

Thank you for your consideration. I look forward to hearing from you.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
cv_highlights:
- Managed social media channels and created digital content (blogs, newsletters, website copy) for client websites at Episto, including planning and optimising paid LinkedIn campaigns.
- Built and maintained WordPress websites with social media integration, and ran SEO analyses using Google Analytics and Search Console at Knowledge Experts.
- Proficient in generative AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude) for content creation and task automation, with strong prompt engineering skills.
- Experienced in design and content creation software including Canva, and familiar with Lumen5 and Adobe tools through web development work.
- Fluent in English with excellent copywriting and storytelling abilities, and a keen interest in health and nutrition topics.
